THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Janaka Bandara Thennakoon, Minister of Lands and LandDevelopment, hereby declare under Sub–section (1) of Section 5 ofthe Land Acquisition Act, that the land described below is needed fora public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of thatAct.

An allotment of land in total extent of about 8.0938 Hectares,depicted in the Advance Tracing No. KU/GNW/2012/503 dated27.11.2012 prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the Villageof Rabawewa 441 Niraviya - Grama Niladhari Division of,Thiththawaligamdahaye Korale, in Divisional Secretary ofGanewatta, Kurunegala District in North Western Province andbounded as folows.
01. Lot ‘‘A’’ – Piterwaliyawatta, Rabawewawatta – Extent:About 8.0938 Hectares
North: Santha Pitharawatta claimed by R. M. Sandya Kumuduni
and K. A. Ramani Sandya Kulathunga of this land, Santha

of this land; East: F. V. P. 1268 (K1040n); South and West: Santha
Pitharawatta claimed by Land Reform Commission.
